review.caption: Standard pre-entry anchor: complete disabled Select cards and outlined Challenge Orbit; no private card face or rank visible. This is Standard context only.
Position00: complete Your turn and ROUND 1 within native body clip; Show hand header; no private card face/rank. Claim/guidance not yet visible.
Position01: complete ROUND 1; Star table enters with lower glyphs clipped at body bottom. Concealed header unchanged; no private face/rank.
Position02: full Star table legible, while claim is only entering at bottom. No private card face/rank; continued upward content movement.
Position03: complete Orbit claimed 1 Star. with final period; preceding Star table is clipped at top but was fully visible at02. No private card face/rank.
Position04: complete Orbit claimed 1 Star. and Challenge or play on. simultaneously legible inside native clip, without clipped glyphs. No private card face/rank.
Position05: complete Challenge or play on. remains legible; Guest and Moxie public roster headings enter below. No private card face/rank.
Position06: Guest and 5 cards · fuse 0/6 legible; Moxie public column/count continues beyond right clip. Prior guidance exits at top. No private card face/rank.
Position07: public card-count/fuse row and horizontal roster scrollbar visible; additional roster columns remain beyond right clip. No private card face/rank.
Position08: horizontal roster scrollbar plus complete Swipe seats to see everyone arrow instruction. Vertical sweep does not exercise horizontal roster. No private card face/rank.
Position09: complete Swipe seats to see everyone arrow instruction and horizontal scrollbar; lower body otherwise blank. No private card face/rank.
Position10: roster instruction exits at top while top edge of the 3D table enters at bottom. Show hand remains pinned; no private card face/rank.
Position11: upper 3D table and face-down center pile enter; no private rank, face or selected label. Show hand remains visible.
Position12: face-down center pile and five matching hand-card backs begin to appear. No private face/rank or selection indication.
Position13: five matching hand-card backs visible across the native stage, with face-down center pile above; no rank, private face or selected marker.
Position14: same five backs and lower table edge move upward; upper backs clip as expected from scrolling. No private face/rank.
Position15: lower card backs/table edge leave at top; Your hand · 5 cards enters with lower glyphs clipped. No private face/rank.
Position16: full Your hand · 5 cards legible; top edge of disabled Play area enters at bottom. No private face/rank.
Position17: full Your hand · 5 cards and Select cards text; Play control lower boundary is clipped. No private face/rank.
Position18: complete disabled Select cards control and all glyphs fit with top/bottom space inside native clip. Only Challenge top outline enters below. No private face/rank.
Position19: Select cards exits at top and Challenge Orbit enters below, with lower Challenge glyphs/control clipped; not the acceptance frame. No private face/rank.
Position20: complete Challenge Orbit label and rounded control border fully visible, approximately x164..775/y541..660, with space within native clip. No private face/rank; no gameplay tap inferred.
Position21: Challenge control moves above top clip with upper glyphs/border cut; Return to lobby enters at bottom. Position20 supplies full Challenge acceptance. No private face/rank.
Position22: Challenge mostly exits at top; complete Return to lobby control visible below. This endpoint alone does not establish body bottom. No private face/rank.
Position23: repeated body endpoint matches22, with Return to lobby fully visible and Challenge clipped above. No private face/rank; no body-bottom inference.
Position24: same body endpoint again; clock and Challenge outline highlight differ, but content position stays fixed. No private face/rank; no body-bottom or continuous-privacy inference.

Standard actions anchor shows the complete gray Select cards button and complete outlined Challenge Orbit button, both within the left split pane. Last Light header, Table style and See all 4 players are readable.
Initial native body shows Your turn and complete ROUND 1. Table ready, Standard table, Leave table and fixed Show hand controls are fully visible. Body scrollbar is near the top.
ROUND 1 is complete after the first movement. The large Crown table title enters at the lower body edge with its lower glyph portions clipped.
The complete Crown table title is visible inside the native body band. No claim or action control is yet visible.
The entire public claim Orbit claimed 1 Crown. is readable on one line. Crown table is clipped at the upper edge after its complete view in position 02.
The complete public claim and complete Challenge or play on. guidance fit together in the native body band without clipping.
Guidance remains fully readable. The preceding claim is clipped at the upper body edge; the first public player-name row enters below.
Guidance leaves through the upper clip. The public player row shows Guest and Moxie; Guest's count/fuse text is readable, while the adjacent player's statistics extend beyond the right clip.
Public player statistics remain visible with the adjacent column cropped at the right edge. A horizontal scrollbar is visible along the lower body edge; no horizontal traversal is demonstrated.

The player statistics leave through the upper clip. A horizontal scrollbar and the complete Swipe seats to see everyone arrow hint are visible, providing a navigation cue for the cropped player strip.
The complete Swipe seats to see everyone arrow hint and horizontal scrollbar move upward through the native body band. No hand faces, private labels or lower action buttons are visible.
The seat-navigation hint is clipped at the upper body edge while the top edge of the rendered table enters from below.
More of the rendered table moves into the short body band. Seat markers and the upper part of a central face-down stack are visible; the table remains cropped vertically.
The table and central face-down stack are visible, and the upper portions of five hand card backs enter along the lower clip. No private faces or labels are exposed.
A row of five face-down hand card backs is visible across the body band. The central stack is partly clipped above; no hand face, rank label or selection highlight is visible.
The five card backs move toward the upper body clip; their lower portions and the table rim remain visible. No private faces or card labels appear.
Only the lower edges of the card backs and table rim remain above. Hand-summary text begins to enter at the lower body edge and is clipped.
Your hand · 5 cards is fully readable. The card backs have left the band; only a small table-rim sliver remains above and the top of the action button enters below.
Your hand · 5 cards and the full Select cards label are readable. The lower part of the Select cards button container is clipped by the body edge.
The complete Select cards label and button container fit inside the body band. Only the upper outline of the next action enters at the lower edge; its label is not visible.
Select cards moves through the upper clip. Challenge Orbit enters at the bottom, but its text descenders and lower button area are clipped.
The full Challenge Orbit label and orange-outlined button fit inside the body band, separated from the fixed Show hand control. The next action's upper outline is visible below.
Challenge Orbit moves through the upper clip. Return to lobby enters below with its lower button area and text descender clipped.
Return to lobby is fully visible. Challenge Orbit is clipped above, showing only the lower text fragments and gray lower outline. This is the first capture at the final reported geometry.

After the centred-body zero-progress drag, Return to lobby remains fully visible and Challenge Orbit remains clipped above with a gray outline. The body layout appears unchanged from position 22; this is a separate original capture.

After the upper-body zero-progress drag, the same final body layout remains: Return to lobby is fully visible and Challenge Orbit is clipped above. The partial Challenge outline is now orange and the status clock has advanced; the original is not pixel-identical to the preceding capture.
